article.title: Seeing Our Power: How Visual Strategy Fuels Our Movements
article.author: Rachel Schragis
article.content: “Our movements often overlook how profoundly visuals can help us maximize threat to power, access our own power, and contest public and media narratives about who we are and what we can achieve,” Rachel Schragis said. On an even deeper level, imagery can help awaken people to the possibilities that they could help make change. “Most of our work is about supporting communities to feel in their soul… Source
